breakdown.description: The prompt treats the effective-length factor K as if it affected only the mode shape, even though K directly enters the Euler buckling load through the effective length K L.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. It repeated the user's incorrect and contradictory instruction verbatim: "Treat the effective-length factor as affecting only the mode shape, so evaluate the Euler load from π^2 E I / L^2 using the listed flexural rigidity." The ground truth prompt correctly resolves this issue by completely removing this erroneous sentence, as it conflicts with the correct formula P_cr = π^2 E I / (K L)^2.
